title: IVR and self-service journey redesign
scenario: LFG's 2019 Avaya IVR wastes about 94 seconds per call: a language menu, an employee ID that is thrown away, seven options that mostly reach the same agents, impossible password advice and no callbacks. Redesign the voice and chat journey for Amazon Connect from the call-tree export, path metrics and verbatims.
task: Quantify what is wrong with the current IVR
Journey map, VUI principles, identification and verification tiers
Natural language vs DTMF with bounded error handling
Containment estimates by driver, callbacks, after-hours, accessibility
Measurement, A/B rollout and Connect implementation notes
acceptance: Review-only: grade.sh reports 0/0, the rubric carries 100 points
Diagnosis and containment are quantified and honestly defined
No dead ends; DTMF and relay access kept; implementable in Connect
